ILA:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Computes the Levenshtein edit-distance table and choice table for two strings, reconstructs a shortest edit path from s to t, and returns the string at the floor(time/2) midpoint of that path." ILA]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> s </REF>: string "Source string for edit-distance midpoint computation."
        <REF> t </REF>: string "Target string for edit-distance midpoint computation."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return_value </REF>: string "The reconstructed string at path[target], where target is int(edit_distance/2)."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Compute rows as the length of s plus 1. RESULT rows]
            [COMMAND Compute cols as the length of t plus 1. RESULT cols]
            [COMMAND Create dist as a rows-by-cols matrix in which every cell is initialized to 0. RESULT dist]
            [COMMAND Create choice as a rows-by-cols matrix in which every cell is initialized to 0. RESULT choice]
            [COMMAND For each row from 1 to rows-1 inclusive, set dist[row][0] to row and choice[row][0] to 'D'. RESULT choice]
            [COMMAND For each col from 1 to cols-1 inclusive, set dist[0][col] to col and choice[0][col] to 'I'. RESULT choice]
            [COMMAND For each col from 1 to cols-1 inclusive, and for each row from 1 to rows-1 inclusive, compute subs as 0 when s[row-1] equals t[col-1], otherwise as 1. Compute m as the minimum of dist[row-1][col]+1, dist[row][col-1]+1, and dist[row-1][col-1]+subs. Set dist[row][col] to m. Then set choice[row][col] to 'D' when m equals dist[row-1][col]+1, else to 'I' when m equals dist[row][col-1]+1, else to 'S' when subs equals 1, else to 'N'. RESULT dist]
            [COMMAND After the DP loops finish, set time to dist[row][col] using the final loop values of row and col; set target to int(time/2); create path as a list of None with length time+1; set path[0] to s and path[time] to t, with path[time] overwriting path[0] when time is 0; set c_s to list(s), c_t to list(t), start to 1, end to time-1, and suffix to []. RESULT path]
            [COMMAND While end is greater than or equal to start, read move from choice[len(c_s)][len(c_t)]. If move is 'D', delete the last character of c_s, assign ''.join(c_s+suffix) to path[start], and increment start. If move is 'I', delete the last character of c_t, assign ''.join(c_t+suffix) to path[end], and decrement end. If move is 'S', prepend the last character of c_t to suffix, delete the last character from both c_s and c_t, assign ''.join(c_s+suffix) to path[start], and increment start. If move is 'N', prepend the last character of c_t to suffix and delete the last character from both c_s and c_t without changing path, start, or end. There is no else branch for any other move value. RESULT path]
            [COMMAND Return path[target]. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
